artifacts.summary: Single-phase plan (1.25h) repairing buildContextExpr via mkAppOptM, relocating both Search.lean call sites inside their observing? blocks, adding invoked regression plus three modal_search acceptance examples, and regenerating two coupled line-count surfaces in the same phase.

memory_candidates.content: A Lean repair verified green by lake build and lake test is NOT yet verified committable in BimodalLogic. Any staged .lean path triggers .githooks/pre-commit, which blocks on scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only drift, and that check compares typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count and tests-line-count against raw `find <dir> -name '*.lean' -exec cat + | wc -l`. A change that moves raw line counts without moving code or comment counts -- deleting blank lines is the clean example -- drifts the typst surface while leaving the root README.md inventory totals (which count code and comment lines separately) untouched. Separately, per-directory README BEGIN GENERATED blocks carry each file's RAW line count, so those drift too. A plan author must schedule `scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix` and `scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` in the SAME phase as the Lean line-count change, because the typst surface is commit-blocking and cannot be deferred to a reconciliation phase. A research dispatch that verifies via builds alone never exercises this gate, so the collision reliably surfaces first at plan or implement time.
